text: {"name":"rf_calibration_status_dump","confidence":"high","docstring":"Logs the current temperature-compensation, crystal-capacitance, RF offset, and RF control settings.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v0":"calibration_state","v1":"settings_enabled","v2":"active_state","v4":"timer_setting"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Temperature-compensation initialization state"},{"offset":1,"meaning":"Temperature-compensation enable flag"},{"offset":2,"meaning":"Temperature-compensation level calibration state"},{"offset":3,"meaning":"Last temperature in Celsius"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Crystal-capacitance calibration value"},{"offset":5,"meaning":"Target crystal capacitance"},{"offset":6,"meaning":"Current crystal capacitance"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"First 2.4 GHz offset correction entry"},{"offset":9,"meaning":"Second 2.4 GHz offset correction entry"},{"offset":10,"meaning":"Third 2.4 GHz offset correction entry"},{"offset":11,"meaning":"First 5 GHz offset correction entry"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"Second 5 GHz offset correction entry"},{"offset":13,"meaning":"Third 5 GHz offset correction entry"},{"offset":363,"meaning":"RF settings enable byte (high byte of the word at offset 360)"},{"offset":364,"meaning":"RF timer setting"}]}
